test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the Indian subcontinent, how many country/countries share its land frontiers with every member country of the subcontinent?
solution:
The correct answer is__** One.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**India** is the central country in the subcontinent and shares land borders with Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, China, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.

 
 
• 
 
Bangladesh shares land borders with India and Myanmar (with Myanmar not being a core country of the Indian subcontinent traditionally).

 
 
• 
 
Nepal and Bhutan share borders only with India.

 Pakistan shares a land border with India and Afghanistan (with Afghanistan sometimes being considered part of the subcontinent).

 
 
• 
 
Given this setup, India is the only country that shares its land borders with all other traditionally recognized member countries of the Indian subcontinent (Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, China and Bangladesh).

 
 
• 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is : One

 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian subcontinent is a region in** South Asia** that includes** India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives. **
 
• India is the **largest country** in the Indian subcontinent and shares its borders with **Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.**
 
• **Pakistan shares its borders with India, Afghanistan, Iran, and China.**
 
• **Nepal** shares its borders with **India and China.**
 
• **Bhutan** shares its borders with **India and China.**
 
• **Sri Lanka and the Maldives are island countries and do not share their borders with any other member country of the Indian subcontinent.**
